name: push-expo
title: Push notifications via Expo
description: Deliver app.push notifications to Expo push tokens (Expo and React Native apps) through the Expo push service, as Expo documents it: batching, throttling, retries and push receipts. Works next to push-fcm.
author: CalmAPI
docs:
Your app gets a token with Notifications.getExpoPushTokenAsync({ projectId }) from expo-notifications and registers it: POST /api/auth/devices { token, platform }. Then send from anywhere: await ctx.push.send({ to: userId, title, body }).
Set EXPO_ACCESS_TOKEN if enhanced push security is on for your Expo project (recommended). Receipts are checked every few minutes; devices whose app was uninstalled are removed.
Install push-fcm too if some devices register native FCM tokens: each token goes to the right service.
